title:
Rates are low.
*Leave your HDB loan?*

lines.say: You're paying 2.6% on your HDB loan. Some bank loans are now well below that.
In 2023, SORA, the rate most floating loans follow, went above 3%.
In the third quarter of 2026, 3-month SORA averaged about 1.2%.
So switching to a bank could cut your interest. But there's a catch.
Once you leave an HDB loan for a bank, you can't go back.
If rates rise again, you ride them. The HDB rate has stayed at 2.6% for years.
Not sure if switching makes sense for you? Comment CHECK.

caption:
Paying 2.6% on your HDB loan while some bank loans are well below that? 🏦

In 2023, SORA (the rate most floating loans follow) went above 3%. In Q3 2026, 3-month SORA averaged about 1.2%.

Switching could cut your interest. The catch: once you leave an HDB loan for a bank, you can't go back. If rates rise again, you ride them.

Not sure if switching makes sense for you? Comment CHECK 👇

Rates for illustration. Bank packages vary. Not financial advice.
